boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations anchoring practical corridors between Lafayette College, College Hill, downtown Easton, the Bushkill Creek, and the riverfront.

cards.title: Follow Sculpture Along the Creek
cards.subtitle: Bushkill Drive corridor
cards.notes: Enter near the College Hill stairs and follow the creek toward 13th Street, using the trail’s interactive map to identify installations.
cards.short_summary: A 1.75-mile sculpture trail links Lafayette’s hill with the Simon Silk Mill.
cards.evidence_claim: The official trail site says the 1.75-mile route follows Bushkill Creek from the Simon Silk Mill to Third Street at the base of the stairs connecting Lafayette’s campuses.
cards.source_title: Karl Stirner Arts Trail — Where Art and Nature Converge
cards.access_notes: Check the official site for trail notices; the dog park is currently closed because of a damaged utility pole, but the notice does not state that the trail is closed.

cards.title: Browse a Reworked Mill Complex
cards.subtitle: North 13th Street and Simon Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Walk the mill grounds and consult the current tenant directory before choosing a studio, shop, service, or scheduled activity to enter.
cards.short_summary: A former silk mill now contains a creative live-work complex and varied small businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: The Simon Silk Mill identifies itself as a creative live-work complex and cultural redevelopment project at 671 North 13th Street and publishes a current business directory.
cards.source_title: Businesses Located at the Simon Silk Mill in Easton, PA
cards.access_notes: Individual tenants set their own access conditions; check the linked directory and the selected tenant before visiting.

cards.title: Make a Library Stop on Church Street
cards.subtitle: Church Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the posted hours to plan a reading or research stop; ask staff about visitor access before relying on borrowing or database privileges.
cards.short_summary: The downtown library offers daytime and evening access near the College Hill route.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official contact page locates the main library at 515 Church Street and lists current hours, including operation until 8 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Contact Us — Easton Area Public Library
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–8 p.m., Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m., and Sunday closed.

cards.entity_name: State Theatre Center for the Arts
cards.title: Check the Marquee on Northampton Street
cards.subtitle: Northampton Street arts corridor
cards.notes: Review the official performance calendar, then use the posted box-office window hours if you need ticket or accessibility information.
cards.short_summary: A historic performing-arts venue gives this downtown block a changing public marquee.
cards.evidence_claim: The theatre’s official page places its box-office window at 453 Northampton Street and documents the venue’s history, operations, and security policies.
cards.source_title: About State Theatre — Mission, History & Community Impact
cards.access_notes: Box office hours are Tuesday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m., and at least two hours before each show; event admission varies.

cards.title: See the Market Hall at Mid-Block
cards.subtitle: 300 block of Northampton Street
cards.notes: Enter from Northampton Street and check individual vendor hours before arranging a meal, grocery stop, or market-kitchen visit.
cards.short_summary: An indoor public market anchors the 300 block with food vendors and a farmstand.
cards.evidence_claim: The market’s official directions page locates Easton Public Market at 325 Northampton Street and publishes current building hours while noting that vendor hours may vary.
cards.access_notes: The building is open Wednesday–Thursday 9 a.m.–7 p.m., Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–8 p.m., and Sunday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; vendors may differ.

cards.title: Read Northampton County Through Objects
cards.subtitle: 300 block of Northampton Street
cards.notes: Bring student identification for the documented student rate, and confirm Sunday exceptions before planning around free admission.
cards.short_summary: County artifacts and exhibitions occupy a dedicated museum on Northampton Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official visit page places Sigal Museum at 342 Northampton Street, lists public hours, and documents general and student admission rates.
cards.access_notes: Open Thursday–Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday noon–4 p.m.; the site lists holiday closures and says Sunday admission exceptions can apply.

cards.title: Find Four Floors of Color Activities
cards.subtitle: Centre Square corridor
cards.notes: Allow several hours if entering the attraction, use the Centre Square doors, and review the official ticket page before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A large family attraction brings hands-on art and color activities to Centre Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Crayola Experience’s official planning page locates the attraction at 30 Centre Square and describes four floors with more than 20 hands-on attractions.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit — Crayola Experience Easton, PA
cards.access_notes: The Centre Square entrance is required during lobby work; admission is ticketed, and children under 15 must be accompanied by an adult.

cards.title: Look for the Little Free Gallery
cards.subtitle: 200 block of Northampton Street
cards.notes: Check the gallery’s current exhibition notice, then look outside for the documented take-one, leave-one miniature art exchange.
cards.short_summary: A long-running gallery adds rotating regional art and a small public art exchange to the block.
cards.evidence_claim: Connexions Gallery’s official site identifies its location as 213 Northampton Street, documents exhibitions, and describes its outdoor Little Free Gallery for art, supplies, and books.
cards.access_notes: The official site should be checked for current exhibitions and events; no dependable daily public hours are stated on the page.

cards.title: Stand at the Two-River Confluence
cards.subtitle: Larry Holmes Drive waterfront corridor
cards.notes: Follow Larry Holmes Drive south of the Northampton Street Bridge for river views, the playground, and the open-air amphitheater.
cards.short_summary: This waterfront park faces the meeting of the Delaware and Lehigh Rivers.
cards.evidence_claim: Easton’s official waterfront page locates Scott Park south of the Northampton Street Bridge on Larry Holmes Drive and documents its confluence views, amphitheater, and playground.
cards.access_notes: The city page describes public park features but does not state operating hours; check city notices and event restrictions before visiting.

cards.title: Circle Easton’s Civic Centerpiece
cards.subtitle: Third Street and Northampton Street corridor
cards.notes: Approach from Third or Northampton Street and use the square as an orientation point for the surrounding downtown blocks.
cards.short_summary: Easton’s named central square marks the junction of its principal downtown corridors.
cards.evidence_claim: Easton’s official facilities directory lists Centre Square at the intersection of Third Street and Northampton Street.
cards.access_notes: The city directory identifies the location but does not provide operating hours or event-specific access details.
